pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/DeepEvalResults/ResultsSection.tsx:182 The green 'No Issues Found / All evaluated modules passed' state depends only on a zero finding count. On the completed path the engine reports every requested module as evaluated (deep-eval-engine.ts:351), errored ones included, so a run where every pass errored still renders as a clean pass next to the failed-modules banner.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/DeepEvalResults/ResultsSection.tsx:182 Zero findings from a run that checked nothing is shown as success; the empty-state is not conditioned on failedModules being empty.

src/components/modules/evaluator/JudgeVerdictsView/verdictRollup.ts:50 Missing provenance is a hole in the instrument, yet it is read as standing, so an unbound PASS raises the current pass count (fail-closed for fails, fail-open for passes).

src/components/modules/evaluator/JudgeVerdictsView/verdictRollup.ts:3 The view reuses the acceptance layer's standing predicate rather than re-deriving its own (apart from the undefined-provenance branch above).
src/components/modules/evaluator/JudgeVerdictsView/verdictRollup.ts:77 Non-standing verdicts are kept and counted by named state (superseded/stale) rather than blanked.
src/components/modules/evaluator/DeepEvalResults/ResultsSection.tsx:134 The failed-module notice names the reason per pass and a remedy (re-run) that is reachable from the same surface.

declined.reason: withdrawn after review: reviewer (sonnet): The claim that the override stamp does not record which findings were waived is contradicted: inputGateOverridden spreads the whole outcome, so reasons and the fail note stay on the record (the test says 'with the fail still on the record'), and only the blanket flag itself is confirmed.
